independentCalculation: For a two-wire DC circuit, the one-way length is doubled. From Ohm's law and conductor resistance R = rho*L/A, the loop resistance is 0.017241*(2*6)/10 = 0.0206892 ohm; multiplying by 15 A gives 0.310338 V. Dividing by 24 V and multiplying by 100 gives 1.293075%. Copper resistivity 0.017241 ohm-mm2/m at 20 C is independently listed by Copper Development Association (Introduction to Copper, Table 5). The two-conductor voltage-drop relation is independently derived in PDHonline Voltage Drop Calculations (2026), Common Formulas, single-phase approximate Equation 2; its stated K/A form is unit-system-specific, while this fixture uses SI resistivity and area.
